		int u, v, f, c, nx;
		edge() {}
		edge(int u, int v, int f, int c, int nx): u(u), v(v), f(f), c(c), nx(nx) {}
	};

	vector<int> head, work, d;
	int n, src, dst;

		vector<int> q(n);
		int le = 0, ri = 0;
		fill(d.begin(), d.end(), -1);
		q[ri++] = src;
		d[src] = 0;
		while(le < ri) {
			int k = q[le++];
			for(int i = head[k]; i != -1; i = e[i].nx) {
				if(e[i].f < e[i].c && d[e[i].v] == -1) {
					d[e[i].v] = d[k] + 1;
					q[ri++] = e[i].v;
				}
			}
		}
		return d[dst] != -1;
	}

	int _dfs(int u, int f) {
		if(u == dst)
			return f;
		for(int& i = work[u]; i != -1; i = e[i].nx) {
			if(e[i].f < e[i].c && d[e[i].v] == d[u] + 1) {
				int minf = _dfs(e[i].v, min(f, e[i].c - e[i].f));
				if(minf > 0) {
					e[i].f += minf;
					e[i ^ 1].f -= minf;
					return minf;
				}
			}
		}
		return 0;
	}

		this->n = n;
		this->src = src;
		this->dst = dst;

		work.resize(n);
		d.resize(n);
	}

	void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
		e.push_back(edge(u, v, 0, c, head[u]));
		head[u] = (int)e.size() - 1;
		e.push_back(edge(v, u, 0, 0, head[v]));
